use_case_summary: Consolidate inference for payments fraud scoring + customer chat into a Private VPC deployment. Require sub-100ms tail latency for online scoring, batch throughput for nightly risk jobs, and strict tokenization/PAN handling for PCI scope.
security_review_summary: SOC 2: Customer requires SOC 2 Type II report and mapping of Redwood controls to their control matrix. Key ask: change management, access reviews, incident response TTRs.
ISO 27001: Need evidence of ISMS coverage for hosting, plus callouts for supply chain (third-party model maintainers). Guidance requested on certificate scope and subcontractor controls.

PCI DSS: Scope reduction preferred (tokenize PAN before model input). Customer insists on architecture that avoids PAN persistence in Redwood-managed storage. Request: ISV guidance on isolating card-data flows and audit log retention for transactions.

KMS Integration: Mandate CMKs in customer's cloud KMS (no exporter). Requirements: envelope encryption, explicit key usage logs, split key admin (customer holds rotation privileges). Need implementation doc + example IAM policies.
Audit Logging: 7-year retention for select audit events; logs must be tamper-evident and exportable in standard formats. They want per-request trace IDs tied to internal ticketing.
Data Residency: EU residency for EU customers, US-only for US regulated products. Ask for region pinning and proof of data flow diagrams (egress allowed only to specified regions).
BAA/HIPAA: Not primary but a gating factor for the healthcare lending pilot. Legal asked whether Redwood can support a BAA and what processing activities would be covered in a Private deployment.
Operational Controls: Role-based access in control plane, mandatory SSO/SAML, periodic access attestation and MFA for admin operators. They asked for sample RBAC matrix.
Pen Test / Attestation: Request for recent penetration test report and remediation timeline; would like ability to schedule a collaborative pen test for the isolated VPC deployment.

Recommendations provided: Private VPC + customer-controlled KMS + tokenization boundary + detailed PCI scope doc + SOC2/ISO deliverables checklist. Next: produce tailored compliance mapping doc and SOW.
